zh: 变位练习新增「显示动词释义」开关，选择题和输入题都可隐藏释义，设置会保存在本机。
动词本恢复动词与释义分行显示。时态栏在桌面放不下时可用左右箭头滚动，手机端可直接横滑。
en: Show or hide verb meanings in multiple-choice and typing practice. ConjuGO saves your preference on this device.
The Verb Book displays the verb and its meaning on separate lines. Use arrows to scroll through tenses on desktop or swipe on a phone.

zh: 四种语言新增分词和副动词专项，覆盖动词本、变位练习和句子测验。
西语补充 usted 和 ustedes，英语补充 it，意大利语补充敬称 Lei，法语补充 vous 的礼貌单数用法。
英语不规则动词的选择题优先考查常见误写和易混词形，每题提供四个不同选项。
新增更新日志，页脚可查看当前版本。
en: Study participles and gerunds across all four languages in the Verb Book, Practice, and Quiz.
Practice Spanish usted and ustedes, English it, Italian polite Lei, and the French polite singular use of vous.
English irregular-verb drills prioritize common misspellings and easily confused forms, with four distinct choices per question.
Open the changelog to see what changed, and check the footer for the current version.
